heads.la: I. AD CAROLUM MAGNUM ODILBERTI ARCHIEPISCOPI RESPONSIO.[Ex Mabill. Vet. Analect.)
heads.en: I. THE REPLY OF ARCHBISHOP ODILBERT TO CHARLEMAGNE.[Ex Mabill. Vet. Analect.)

heads.la: II. EPISTOLA CAROLI MAGNI AD OFFAM REGEM. Mittit in Britanniam concilium Nicaenum II.
heads.en: II. LETTER OF CHARLEMAGNE TO KING OFFA. He sends into Britain the Second Council of Nicaea.

heads.la: III. EPISTOLA AD CAROLUM MAGNUM IMPERATOREM. De ritibus baptismi. Haec est epistola quam ad aures domni imperatoris direximus.
heads.en: III. LETTER TO THE EMPEROR CHARLEMAGNE. On the rites of baptism. [n: (Ex Martene, Thesaurus anecd.)] This is the letter which we have directed to the ears of the lord emperor.

heads.la: IV. ANONYMI SCRIPTORIS RESPONSIO AD CAPITULA ARCHIEPISCOPIS REGNI FRANCORUM MISSA A CAROLO MAGNO, ANNO CHRISTI DCCCXI. Haec sunt causae quas domnus imperator Augustus nobis ad utilitatem semper sanctae Ecclesiae per sacram suam mandavit epistolam.
heads.en: IV. THE REPLY OF AN ANONYMOUS WRITER TO THE CHAPTERS SENT BY CHARLEMAGNE TO THE ARCHBISHOPS OF THE KINGDOM OF THE FRANKS, IN THE YEAR OF CHRIST 811.[n: (Ex Baluzio.)] These are the matters which the lord emperor Augustus enjoined upon us for the benefit of the ever-holy Church by his sacred letter.

heads.la: CAP. I. Quomodo vel qualiter unusquisque Dei sacerdos plebem sibi a Deo commissam insinuat, praedicat atque gubernat.
heads.en: CHAP. I. In what way, or how, each priest of God imparts, preaches, and governs the people committed to him by God.

heads.la: CAP. II. De omni sancti mysterio baptismatis quo [si] ordine debemus celebramus.
heads.en: CHAP. II. On the whole holy mystery of baptism, in what order we ought [si] to celebrate.

heads.la: CAP. III. Cur catechumenus fit, et cujus linguae, et quid interpretatur.
heads.en: CHAP. III. Why one becomes a catechumen, and of what tongue, and what it is interpreted.

heads.la: IV. CAP. De scrutinio ecclesiastico, cur scrutinium fit, et quo tempore, et quid est scrutinium.
heads.en: IV. CHAP. On ecclesiastical scrutiny: why scrutiny is made, and at what time, and what scrutiny is.
